'''Spensor Kluub''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] living on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Cloud Cover" />

He used a private booth at the [[Well-Done Bantha]] as his office and was the most respected slicer on Cloud City after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="Cloud Cover" />

At one point, both [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents sought his help to decode a datapad containing the coordinates to the Rebel [[Safe world/Legends|Safe world]] [[Kaliska]].<ref name="Cloud Cover" />
